LightningComponentBundle.description: A policy's coverages as designed rows, grouped by what they protect: an icon, the coverage, what it pays for in a plain line, the limit and how it applies, the deductible, and its share of the premium.

property.name: parentField
property.label: Lookup to the policy
property.description: Leave empty on a policy page. On a coverage or insured asset page, the record's lookup to its policy (Policy__c): the card then shows that policy's coverages.

property.name: rows
property.label: Coverages shown at a time
property.description: Leave empty to show every coverage, as on a policy page. In a narrow column, a number such as 8: the rest are stepped to, so the card stays under a screen.
